title: Navy Blue Account: Paper vs E-Statements
summary: This document explains how Navy Blue Accounts handle paper vs e-statements: e-statements are delivered electronically at no cost via your online banking portal, while monthly paper statements have a $0.00 fee but require a valid mailing address and may take longer. It also covers how to switch preferences in document settings and notes that historical statements remain available based on retention settings.
